photos.c: Above: A mile gone in the men’s race and Barry Royden (847 Medway & Maidstone) holds a narrow lead with Matt Ashton (3 Aldershot F&D), Darren Deed (61 Bedford &C) and Phil Wicks (100 Belgrave) in echelon. Just behind Royden is Huw Lobb (Bedford), Dominic Bannister (Shaftesbury) and Andy Robinson (Newham & Essex Beagles).
